mapper.select: SELECT dev_id AS "id",mng_no AS "managementNo" FROM tb_hr_dev ORDER BY dev_id

SELECT c.code_grp_id AS "groupId",c.code,c.code_nm AS "name",(c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y') AS "active",m.src_text AS "source" FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code_map m ON m.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id AND m.code=c.code WHERE c.code_grp_id IN ('JOB','INPUT_TYPE','EXT_PSBL','ASGN_CHG_RSN') ORDER BY c.code_grp_id,c.code,m.map_id

SELECT json_build_object( 'assignments',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(a) ORDER BY asgn_id) FROM tb_pj_asgn a),'[]'::json), 'history',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(h) ORDER BY asgn_id,hist_sn) FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist h),'[]'::json), 'months',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(m) ORDER BY asgn_id,input_ym) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m),'[]'::json), 'projects',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(p) ORDER BY proj_id) FROM tb_pj_proj p),'[]'::json), 'developers',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(d) ORDER BY dev_id) FROM tb_hr_dev d),'[]'::json), 'prices',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(p) ORDER BY dev_id,aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_hr_dev_prc p),'[]'::json), 'close',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(c) ORDER BY close_ym) FROM tb_cl_close c),'[]'::json), 'standards',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(s) ORDER BY std_cd,aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_sy_oper_std s WHERE std_cd IN ('MM_OVER','CASH_BASE_YM')),'[]'::json), 'codes',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(c) ORDER BY code_grp_id,code) FROM tb_sy_code c WHERE code_grp_id IN ('JOB','INPUT_TYPE','EXT_PSBL','ASGN_CHG_RSN')),'[]'::json))::text
mapper.sql: upld_id AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS "filename",file_size AS "size",reg_user_id AS "actor",upld_stat_cd AS "status",tot_row_cnt AS "totalRows",succ_cnt AS "successRows",warn_cnt AS "warningRows",err_cnt AS "errorRows"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT rslt_sn AS "sequence",rslt_type_cd AS "severity",row_no AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName",coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS "reason" FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY rslt_sn
SELECT chg_item_nm AS "item",aft_val AS "value" FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_UPLD' AND trgt_key=CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) AND chg_rsn=#{reason} ORDER BY hist_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET upld_stat_cd='APPLIED',aply_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
